gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests {@link ArrayFill#fill(Object[], FailableIntFunction)}, the generator-based overload that computes each element from its index.
ADDED i2: A null input array is returned unchanged (as null), regardless of the generator.
ADDED i3: An empty input array is returned unchanged (still empty), regardless of the generator.
ADDED i4: A non-empty array is populated in place: element i becomes generator.apply(i).
ADDED i5: fill returns the same array instance it was given (fluent style).
ADDED i6: Each element equals its own index, since the generator is Integer::valueOf.
